description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry
categorisation: This gazette content involves the appointment of judges (Hon. Dhammika Priyantha Samarakoon Jayawardena, Hon. Khema Kumudini Wickremasinghe, and Hon R. M. Sobhitha Rajakaruna) to a Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry. The content focuses on judicial appointments and the expansion of their investigative mandate, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters rather than general government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
